```{r}
set.seed(2)

means <- matrix(c(c(1.5, 2),
         c(-2.5, 1),
         c(0, -1.25)), nrow = 3, ncol = 2, byrow = T)

cov_1 <- matrix(c(1, -0.4,
                  -0.4, 1), nrow=2)
cov_2 <- matrix(c(1, 0.5,
                  0.5, 1), nrow=2)
cov_3 <- matrix(c(1, 0,
                  0, 1), nrow=2)
covs <- array(c(cov_1, cov_2, cov_3), dim = c(2, 2, 3))
trial = generate_trial(3, 20, means, covs)

X <- trial$X
E <- X - trial$U
labels <- trial$labels

grid_points <- expand.grid(seq(min(X[, 1]), max(X[, 1]), 0.01), 
                           seq(min(X[, 2]), max(X[, 2]), 0.01))

density_tibble <- tibble(
  x = rep(grid_points[, 1], 3),
  y = rep(grid_points[, 2], 3),
  density = c(dmvnorm(grid_points, mean = means[1,], sigma = covs[,, 1]),
              dmvnorm(grid_points, mean = means[2,], sigma = covs[,, 2]),
              dmvnorm(grid_points, mean = means[3,], sigma = covs[,, 3])),
  label = rep(c(1, 2, 3), each = nrow(grid_points))
)

```

```{r}
plot_affinity_graph <- function(points_df, edges_df, title = "", density_tibble = NA,
                                alpha_weights = F) {
  num_clusters <- length(unique(points_df$label))
  if(is_tibble(density_tibble)) {
    density_geom <- geom_contour(
      data = density_tibble,
      aes(x, y, z = density, color = factor(label), group = label),
      alpha = 0.5, bins = 8)
  } else {
    density_geom <- geom_blank()
  }
  
  if(alpha_weights) {
    edges_geom <- geom_segment(
      data = edges_df |> filter(from > to),
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        xend = xend,
        yend = yend,
        alpha = value
      ),
      linewidth = 1
    )
  } else {
    edges_geom <- geom_segment(
      data = edges_df |> filter(from > to),
      aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      linewidth = 1
    )
  }
  ggplot(points_df) +
    density_geom +
    edges_geom +
    geom_point(aes(x, y, shape = factor(label), fill = factor(label)), 
               size = 3, stroke = 0.75) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 21:25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=colorblind_pal()(num_clusters + 1)[-1]) +
    scale_color_manual(values=colorblind_pal()(num_clusters + 1)[-1], guide = "none") +
    labs(fill = "True Component", shape = "True Component") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
          axis.title.y=element_blank()) +
    ggtitle(title)
}

```

```{r}
plot_solution_path <- function(points_df, solution_path_df, cluster_df, num_est_clusters, title = "", density_tibble = NA) {
  manual_fill <- hue_pal()(num_est_clusters)
  
  points_df <- points_df |>
    inner_join(cluster_df |> 
                 filter(num_cluster == num_est_clusters), by = "id")

  if(is_tibble(density_tibble)) {
    density_geom <- geom_contour(
      data = density_tibble, 
      aes(x, y, z = density, color = factor(label), group = label),
                    alpha = 0.5, bins = 8)
  } else {
    density_geom <- geom_blank()
  }
  ggplot(points_df) +
    density_geom + 
    geom_path(data = solution_path_df, aes(x = x, y = y, group = id)) +
    geom_point(aes(x, y, shape = factor(label), fill = factor(est_label)),
               size = 3, stroke = 0.75) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 21:25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = manual_fill) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colorblind_pal()(3 + 1)[-1], guide = "none") +
    labs(shape = "True Component") +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes=list(color=manual_fill),
                          title = "Estimated Component", order = 0),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 1)
    ) +
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
          axis.title.y=element_blank()) +
    ggtitle(title)
}

```

```{r}
plot_affinity_diagnostics <- function(points_df, edges_df, title = "") {
  num_clusters <- length(unique(points_df$label))

  ggplot(points_df) +
    geom_segment(data = edges_df |> filter(from < to), 
                 aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, 
                     linetype = `Within-component Edge`, color = F_dagger_row_norm),
                 alpha = 1, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(x, y, shape = factor(label), fill = factor(label)), 
               size = 3, stroke = 0.75) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 21:25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorblind_pal()(num_clusters + 1)[-1]) +
    labs(fill = "True Component", shape = "True Component") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", begin = 0, end = 0.90,
                          name = TeX("$\\|F^\\dagger_{i \\cdot}\\|_2$")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("41", "solid")) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          legend.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)) +
    guides(
      linetype = guide_legend(order = -1),
      shape = guide_legend(order = -2),
      fill = guide_legend(order = -2)
    ) +
    ggtitle(title)
}

```

plot_affinity_diagnostics(knn_solutions_3$plot_dfs$points,
                          knn_solutions_3$plot_dfs$edges,
                          "3-nearest neighbors graph for mixture model samples")

plot_affinity_diagnostics(knn_solutions_4$plot_dfs$points,

plot_affinity_diagnostics(knn_solutions_5$plot_dfs$points,
